answer: Each newcomer must pay its entry fee in something that cannot be mass-produced: a signed sample of nectar drawn from one named dune, sealed by a lab that mixes its violet dye in a single numbered batch. A farm spinning up ten thousand puppet identities would need ten thousand separate samples, and the dye registry would immediately show one batch number reused. Honest agents verify cheaply, while forgery collapses under its own material cost.
